definitions.explanation: Describes a large degree of change, increase, decrease, or adjustment. Emphasizes that something is not minor but considerable in scale.

examples.japanese: ⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{大幅|おおはば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{下|さ}がった→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
⟦スケジュール→スケジュール：03850_sukejuuru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{大幅|おおはば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}する→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a need to make drastic changes to the schedule.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}→導入：10127_dounyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{大幅|おおはば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{短縮|たんしゅく}→短縮：13665_tanshuku⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The introduction of a new system substantially reduced the work time.

notes:
USAGE:
Very frequently used with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ as an adverb ({大幅|おおはば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧) to modify verbs indicating change. Common in news, business reports, and formal writing. Almost always refers to the magnitude of a change rather than a static quality.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大幅|おおはば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧: to increase substantially
- {大幅|おおはば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{減|へ}る→減る：01985_heru⟧: to decrease substantially
- {大幅|おおはば}な⟦{値上|ねあ}げ→値上げ：07582_neage⟧: a substantial price increase
- {大幅|おおはば}な⟦{改善|かいぜん}→改善：00144_kaizen⟧: a significant improvement
- {大幅|おおはば}な⟦{見直|みなお}し→見直し：09340_minaoshi⟧: a major review/overhaul
